hooks.command: [ -z "$AGENT_INBOX" ] || { t=$(jq -r '.transcript_path // empty'); n=$([ -f "$t" ] && tac "$t" | jq -nR 'first(inputs | fromjson? | select(.type == "assistant" and .isSidechain != true) | .message.usage // empty | .input_tokens + .cache_creation_input_tokens + .cache_read_input_tokens) // empty'); [ -z "$n" ] || vibetogether inbox context "$n" "${CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONTEXT_TOKENS:-1000000}"; vibetogether inbox take; }
